option_relations.rationale: SARS-CoV-2–associated optic neuritis is a specific type of optic neuritis, and B1.1 is a more specific diagnosis that includes retinal vasculitis
Immune-mediated parainfectious optic neuritis is a broader category that includes various types of optic neuritis
COVID-19-associated optic neuritis and retinal vasculitis is a direct match with B1.1
Inflammation-induced ocular neuropathy associated with SARS-CoV-2–induced panuveitis is a related condition that may include optic neuritis and retinal vasculitis
